A '''hull patch''',<ref name="GSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> also known as a '''hull seal patch''',<ref name="TDC">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref> was an emergency repair device used to temporarily repair breaches in the outer [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. Hull patches used a variety of methods for affixing themselves, including adhesive, mechanical, or magnetic seals.<ref name="GSWU" /> Hull patches could also be used aboard aquatic vessels in the event of a hull rupture.<ref name="SR">{{JournalCite|1|The Spira Regatta}}</ref>
